attributes.check1: Intelligence or Knowledge or Wisdom or Survival 11
attributes.name: Jagged Shoals
attributes.powers:
You may recharge any number of allies; for each ally recharged, add 1d4 to your check to defeat this barrier.

If undefeated, your ship is dealt 1d4+1 Structural damage. Leave this barrier faceup on the location deck; characters at this location encounter this barrier as their first exploration each turn.
